# recipes.md — generated from minecraft-data 26.1
# Generated by facts/gen-facts.js from the game's own recipe tables.
# Ingredient names are material GROUPS where the game accepts variants
# (e.g. planks(any wood) = oak, spruce, birch... planks all work).

## Gathered, not crafted
- any *_log: dug from tree trunks by hand.
- cobblestone: stone dug with any pickaxe drops cobblestone 1:1.
- coal: coal_ore dug with any pickaxe drops coal 1:1.
- dirt, gravel, sand: dug by hand or shovel.

## Smelting (furnace, any fuel: planks, logs, coal, charcoal)
- 1x log -> 1x charcoal
- 1x raw_beef -> 1x cooked_beef; raw_porkchop -> cooked_porkchop;
  raw_mutton -> cooked_mutton; raw_chicken -> cooked_chicken; potato -> baked_potato
